[{"end_line":199,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA - Typed Compute Algebra And LLM Authoring Boundary/Requirements","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md#REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA%20-%20Typed%20Compute%20Algebra%20And%20LLM%20Authoring%20Boundary%2FRequirements","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","sha256":"45948c1e5133e04fa00e80ab5e3135ea4b9dd58b4576be73e452130bee62675b","start_line":39,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","lines":[{"number":39,"text":"## Requirements
"},{"number":40,"text":"
"},{"number":41,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-001 - Closed generator set.** The compute algebra
"},{"number":42,"text":"generator set is exactly `C.of`, `C.id`, `C.compose`, `C.edge`, `workflow.C`,
"},{"number":43,"text":"`C.batch`, and `C.retry`. A build tenant shall represent the set with an
"},{"number":44,"text":"exhaustively matchable typed carrier. The canonical transform/evaluate/
"},{"number":45,"text":"consequence edge is bootstrap data expressed by the algebra, not a closed stage
"},{"number":46,"text":"ontology.
"},{"number":47,"text":"
"},{"number":48,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-002 - Unit.**
"},{"number":49,"text":"`C.of<A,B,Role,Fibre>(stage<A,B,Role,Fibre>) -> C<A,B>` introduces one atomic
"},{"number":50,"text":"C-call leaf. The enclosing `CProgramDeclaration.programRef` supplies program
"},{"number":51,"text":"identity; the leaf supplies role, fibre, arm, and input/output carrier refs.
"},{"number":52,"text":"Together they name one `(program, role, fibre, arm)` census member. The leaf
"},{"number":53,"text":"has one C-call spine and an implementation may realize only its interior.
"},{"number":54,"text":"
"},{"number":55,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-003 - Identity.** `C.id<A> -> C<A,A>` is the left and
"},{"number":56,"text":"right identity of composition. It projects `no_declared_check` only where the
"},{"number":57,"text":"owning contract demands no check. It cannot satisfy a required gate and cannot
"},{"number":58,"text":"make an otherwise empty executable edge program complete.
"},{"number":59,"text":"
"},{"number":60,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-004 - Composition.**
"},{"number":61,"text":"`C.compose<A,B,D>(C<A,B>, C<B,D>) -> C<A,D>` is closed and associative.
"},{"number":62,"text":"Composition is flat by default: nested syntax erases to the ordered `C.of`
"},{"number":63,"text":"leaves in one declared boundary. Input/output mismatch is a type error where
"},{"number":64,"text":"the host language can decide it and otherwise a typed GTL-validator gap.
"},{"number":65,"text":"
"},{"number":66,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-005 - Edge record.** `C.edge` is the named record form
"},{"number":67,"text":"of a composition containing transform, evaluate, and consequence roles. The
"},{"number":68,"text":"three fields are atomic direct `C.of` leaves with the corresponding stage-role
"},{"number":69,"text":"literal; wrapping or composition occurs outside the record. The roles remain
"},{"number":70,"text":"ordinary declared stages. Open programs may contain other non-empty roles and
"},{"number":71,"text":"shall name exactly one result-bearing role.
"},{"number":72,"text":"
"},{"number":73,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-006 - Named workflow lift.**
"},{"number":74,"text":"`workflow.C(GraphFunctionRef<A,B>) -> C<A,B>` is the only constructor that
"},{"number":75,"text":"makes an admitted graph-function traversal one transparent C at its parent
"},{"number":76,"text":"level. The typed `GraphFunctionRef` binds the admitted graph function and the
"},{"number":77,"text":"declared C input/output carriers; the lift preserves that `A,B` pair. Raw
"},{"number":78,"text":"validation proves that the named graph function resolves. Equality between
"},{"number":79,"text":"those carrier refs and a child's published wire contract requires an admitted
"},{"number":80,"text":"outer-contract identity and shall not be inferred when that identity is absent.
"},{"number":81,"text":"The lift yields `sub_traversal` evidence. Anonymous nesting never creates a
"},{"number":82,"text":"frame or monad boundary.
"},{"number":83,"text":"
"},{"number":84,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-007 - Batch.** `C.batch(tasks, batchRef)` groups a
"},{"number":85,"text":"non-empty ordered task family whose members have the same input carrier,
"},{"number":86,"text":"output carrier, and per-task result cardinality. Stable list position pairs
"},{"number":87,"text":"tasks when applying a pointwise distributive law. The batch preserves one
"},{"number":88,"text":"C-call spine and one result-cardinality judgment per invoking task plus one
"},{"number":89,"text":"non-authoritative parent grouping ref; its program cardinality is that shared
"},{"number":90,"text":"per-task cardinality, not an aggregate `many`. Batch distributes over
"},{"number":91,"text":"composition only for equal-length compatible task families paired by stable
"},{"number":92,"text":"position. A batch never collapses task identity, evidence, or judgment into
"},{"number":93,"text":"one synthetic call.
"},{"number":94,"text":"
"},{"number":95,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-008 - Retry.** `C.retry(C<A,B>, budget) -> C<A,B>`
"},{"number":96,"text":"preserves the input/output contract and closes attempts under the one declared
"},{"number":97,"text":"retryable-failure allowlist. The budget is a positive declared value. Retry
"},{"number":98,"text":"does not create a per-fibre error algebra or authorize undeclared repair.
"},{"number":99,"text":"
"},{"number":100,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-009 - Role/fibre orthogonality.** Stage role is open
"},{"number":101,"text":"declared program data. Fibre is one of `F_D`, `F_P`, or `F_H`. Substituting a
"},{"number":102,"text":"lawful fibre changes the selected interior and evidence class only; it does not
"},{"number":103,"text":"change graph topology, program membership, spine kinds, spine order, or spine
"},{"number":104,"text":"count. The GTL validator, HoG, and ABG preserve the declared fibre and never
"},{"number":105,"text":"reclassify semantic `F_P` work as `F_D` from observed behavior. Replacing a
"},{"number":106,"text":"prior `F_P` declaration with `F_D` is a declaration-version and annealing
"},{"number":107,"text":"decision governed by the tuner/equivalence requirements, not a local validator
"},{"number":108,"text":"inference.
"},{"number":109,"text":"
"},{"number":110,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-010 - Implementation matching.** A plugin or handler
"},{"number":111,"text":"binding shall match the enclosing program identity and selected stage role,
"},{"number":112,"text":"fibre, and arm. C input/output carrier continuity is a GTL-validator
"},{"number":113,"text":"judgment. Each implementation separately matches the published carrier
"},{"number":114,"text":"contract of its plugin or handler seam; a uniform engine-plugin transport
"},{"number":115,"text":"carrier is not falsely equated with the domain C carrier ref. Its public type
"},{"number":116,"text":"and admitted carrier shall not provide event emission, traversal selection,
"},{"number":117,"text":"continuation, ledger, or closure authority. ABG admits its result and owns all
"},{"number":118,"text":"resulting runtime truth.
"},{"number":119,"text":"
"},{"number":120,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-011 - No rival execution declaration.** The admitted
"},{"number":121,"text":"GTL program, its C declaration, GraphFunction templates, and implementation
"},{"number":122,"text":"bindings are the complete execution declaration. `abg.hog_program`,
"},{"number":123,"text":"`abg.hog_program_catalog`, `abg.hog_program_ref`,
"},{"number":124,"text":"`abg.hog_program_ladder`, generated handler-program declarations, or any
"},{"number":125,"text":"equivalent compiled runtime program shall be rejected as executable authority.
"},{"number":126,"text":"Implementation bindings may identify declared leaf seams only. Opaque
"},{"number":127,"text":"extension data shall not acquire runtime meaning by convention.
"},{"number":128,"text":"
"},{"number":129,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-012 - Native-language maximum.** Each conforming build
"},{"number":130,"text":"tenant shall use its native static type system and API patterns as far as they
"},{"number":131,"text":"can decide the law: discriminated unions, generic input/output relations,
"},{"number":132,"text":"nominal or opaque admitted states, exhaustive matching, constructor-only
"},{"number":133,"text":"creation, and role/fibre/host-indexed bindings. The GTL validator shall not
"},{"number":134,"text":"be used as an excuse to erase locally decidable types into strings or bags.
"},{"number":135,"text":"
"},{"number":136,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-013 - Canonical-data admission.** Authored GTL remains
"},{"number":137,"text":"canonical pure data. Untyped files, generated data, package input, and API
"},{"number":138,"text":"payloads enter through raw admission that applies the same sort and relation
"},{"number":139,"text":"judgments as the native typed API. Native callers use the published typed
"},{"number":140,"text":"constructors; serialized callers use raw admission. Authored, admitted,
"},{"number":141,"text":"validated, and runtime values remain distinct states. A deterministic
"},{"number":142,"text":"native constructor is lawful only as a projection into that canonical data:
"},{"number":143,"text":"serialization plus raw readmission must preserve the exact value and digest.
"},{"number":144,"text":"Its loops, branching, and string construction do not become declaration
"},{"number":145,"text":"authority and may not consult ambient or runtime truth.
"},{"number":146,"text":"
"},{"number":147,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-014 - Semantic gap ownership.** The GTL validator shall
"},{"number":148,"text":"decide closed facts that a local host type cannot: decoded input, references
"},{"number":149,"text":"reachable from the submitted root, program and catalog membership, carrier
"},{"number":150,"text":"continuity, result cardinality, constructor coverage, and implementation-seam
"},{"number":151,"text":"declaration completeness. Runtime admission shall decide environment-specific
"},{"number":152,"text":"availability and probabilistic result facts. A lawful term with no admitted
"},{"number":153,"text":"realization produces `semantic_not_realized`; an unresolved named reference
"},{"number":154,"text":"produces `invalid_program`; neither is silently lowered into another term or
"},{"number":155,"text":"compiled plan.
"},{"number":156,"text":"
"},{"number":157,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-015 - LLM repair protocol.** C-algebra conformance
"},{"number":158,"text":"failures shall carry a stable diagnostic identity, subject path, governing
"},{"number":159,"text":"axiom and requirement refs, evidence, and admissible repair moves. Direct
"},{"number":160,"text":"execution-declaration admission shall carry a stable typed refusal prefix and
"},{"number":161,"text":"reason before effects. Rich C diagnostics name the expected and actual sort or
"},{"number":162,"text":"relation; generic declaration diagnostics may use their stable rule, message,
"},{"number":163,"text":"evidence, and repair fields. Repair moves identify lawful constructors,
"},{"number":164,"text":"declaration surfaces, reference corrections, or constitutional re-entry. They
"},{"number":165,"text":"do not select, perform, or authorize a repair.
"},{"number":166,"text":"
"},{"number":167,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-016 - Validate before effects.** A program with a local
"},{"number":168,"text":"type failure, admission failure, or unresolved semantic gap shall stop before
"},{"number":169,"text":"worker/plugin invocation, archive writes, traversal, or successful assessment
"},{"number":170,"text":"or closure truth. Diagnostic fail-closed events may report the typed refusal
"},{"number":171,"text":"and terminal stop. HoG shall traverse only the original admitted GTL terms. It
"},{"number":172,"text":"shall not parse new program meaning, infer types from observed behavior, or
"},{"number":173,"text":"repair declarations. Validation and traversal admission preserve every
"},{"number":174,"text":"authored C stage, its order, role, fibre, arm, carriers, and result-bearing
"},{"number":175,"text":"designation. HoG- and ABG-owned call preparation, result admission, evidence
"},{"number":176,"text":"binding, and materialization are subordinate runtime transitions. They may
"},{"number":177,"text":"surround an authored stage but shall not form a rival runtime plan or replace,
"},{"number":178,"text":"rename, reorder, or count as authored program membership.
"},{"number":179,"text":"
"},{"number":180,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-017 - Conformance corpus.** The language conformance
"},{"number":181,"text":"corpus shall pair canonical positive and negative LLM-authored programs with
"},{"number":182,"text":"exact expected diagnostic identities. It shall cover sort coercion, interface
"},{"number":183,"text":"mismatch, role/fibre confusion, implementation mismatch, illegal declaration
"},{"number":184,"text":"host, duplicate authority, malformed serialized data, required declarations
"},{"number":185,"text":"named by declared references but absent from the submitted root, inferred
"},{"number":186,"text":"undeclared terms, every realized algebra law above, and stable
"},{"number":187,"text":"`semantic_not_realized` results for lawful unrealized constructors.
"},{"number":188,"text":"
"},{"number":189,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA-018 - F_P response admission.** The standard `F_P`
"},{"number":190,"text":"transform, runtime-failure, and live-evaluator responses used by this execution
"},{"number":191,"text":"surface are data until ABG admits their closed schemas, required identities and
"},{"number":192,"text":"evidence references, and cross-field invariants. Attached result artifacts
"},{"number":193,"text":"admit their base envelope and closed assessment rows while domain extension
"},{"number":194,"text":"sections remain governed by the selected declared artifact schema. Malformed
"},{"number":195,"text":"output produces a typed blocked or rejected result. Incomplete or contradictory
"},{"number":196,"text":"evaluation output produces retry or blocked truth, never accepted closure by
"},{"number":197,"text":"omission. Raw diagnostic evidence may be retained. This is model-output
"},{"number":198,"text":"validation, not hostile-process tamper protection.
"},{"number":199,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":217,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA - Typed Compute Algebra And LLM Authoring Boundary/Operating Trust Boundary","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md#REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA%20-%20Typed%20Compute%20Algebra%20And%20LLM%20Authoring%20Boundary%2FOperating%20Trust%20Boundary","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","sha256":"fb26d10a92e7179f801770677ed5c9d11dcbf18c9e3ac65e50e979ed1dec44d1","start_line":200,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","lines":[{"number":200,"text":"## Operating Trust Boundary
"},{"number":201,"text":"
"},{"number":202,"text":"The current product is a single-developer desktop tool. Native code running in
"},{"number":203,"text":"the process and values already returned by the published typed constructors are
"},{"number":204,"text":"trusted. This requirement does not require tamper-proofing against hostile
"},{"number":205,"text":"in-process code, reflected private fields, forged local objects, filesystem
"},{"number":206,"text":"attackers, or cryptographic artifact substitution.
"},{"number":207,"text":"
"},{"number":208,"text":"Malformed authored GTL is expected and shall be rejected by native type
"},{"number":209,"text":"matching, raw admission, lint/source guards, or GTL validation at the
"},{"number":210,"text":"earliest boundary capable of deciding the fault. `F_P` output is probabilistic
"},{"number":211,"text":"external data and remains subject to its published result-schema admission and
"},{"number":212,"text":"contradiction checks before ABG projects accepted assessment or closure truth.
"},{"number":213,"text":"Raw observed/diagnostic evidence and non-close retry truth may be retained.
"},{"number":214,"text":"This requirement owns the declaration and implementation match leading to that
"},{"number":215,"text":"seam; the applicable ABG plugin/result requirement owns the returned-output
"},{"number":216,"text":"schema.
"},{"number":217,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":230,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA - Typed Compute Algebra And LLM Authoring Boundary/Conformance Root","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md#REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA%20-%20Typed%20Compute%20Algebra%20And%20LLM%20Authoring%20Boundary%2FConformance%20Root","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","sha256":"e94603573c4672cbe8e2acd2e136d13c795fe0c4ffb01edef8d22c804fde68b9","start_line":218,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","lines":[{"number":218,"text":"## Conformance Root
"},{"number":219,"text":"
"},{"number":220,"text":"A conformance report is scoped to one admitted submitted root identified by
"},{"number":221,"text":"`subjectRef`: its admitted module, program, graph-function, and catalog rows, plus its
"},{"number":222,"text":"declared expected-coverage contract. The GTL validator checks every declaration
"},{"number":223,"text":"reachable from that root and reports required rows missing relative to that
"},{"number":224,"text":"bound coverage contract where the contract carries an applicable inventory
"},{"number":225,"text":"field. For execution declarations, the validator proves declared-reference
"},{"number":226,"text":"completeness and internal membership; the current coverage carrier does not
"},{"number":227,"text":"express a total expected execution-declaration inventory. Product/install
"},{"number":228,"text":"binding selects the authoritative root and complete release manifest. Those
"},{"number":229,"text":"are separate release contracts.
"},{"number":230,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":251,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA - Typed Compute Algebra And LLM Authoring Boundary/Algebra Laws","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md#REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA%20-%20Typed%20Compute%20Algebra%20And%20LLM%20Authoring%20Boundary%2FAlgebra%20Laws","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","sha256":"89838daff3fd046965381d5bb3ac5bcd169a3a83d9f052b93cfdab108fcab928","start_line":231,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","lines":[{"number":231,"text":"## Algebra Laws
"},{"number":232,"text":"
"},{"number":233,"text":"For all well-typed terms where the named boundaries and effects agree:
"},{"number":234,"text":"
"},{"number":235,"text":"```text
"},{"number":236,"text":"C.compose(C.id, c) == c
"},{"number":237,"text":"C.compose(c, C.id) == c
"},{"number":238,"text":"C.compose(C.compose(a, b), c) == C.compose(a, C.compose(b, c))
"},{"number":239,"text":"workflow.C(GraphFunctionRef<A,B>) preserves the ref's declared A,B contract
"},{"number":240,"text":"C.retry(c, n) preserves the contract of c
"},{"number":241,"text":"C.batch distributes pointwise over C.compose for equal-length ordered task families
"},{"number":242,"text":"fibre substitution preserves C-call spine shape
"},{"number":243,"text":"```
"},{"number":244,"text":"
"},{"number":245,"text":"Equality is canonical semantic equality under admitted identity and normalized
"},{"number":246,"text":"declaration data, not host object identity.
"},{"number":247,"text":"
"},{"number":248,"text":"The `workflow.C` law does not synthesize a missing wire-level outer-contract
"},{"number":249,"text":"identity. A build may certify equality to the child GraphFunction contract only
"},{"number":250,"text":"when that relation is present as admitted language data.
"},{"number":251,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":259,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA - Typed Compute Algebra And LLM Authoring Boundary/Non-Conformance","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md#REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA%20-%20Typed%20Compute%20Algebra%20And%20LLM%20Authoring%20Boundary%2FNon-Conformance","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","sha256":"33687cc0165b4f6bf2191c3d32f1aff8a18b07eb55e7ab5bbb275743907d964e","start_line":252,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-C-ALGEBRA.md","lines":[{"number":252,"text":"## Non-Conformance
"},{"number":253,"text":"
"},{"number":254,"text":"A toolchain is non-conforming when it relies on prose prompting to prevent a
"},{"number":255,"text":"category error that the native type system or GTL validator could reject;
"},{"number":256,"text":"when a bound submitted root can omit a declaration required by its own module,
"},{"number":257,"text":"catalog, or expected-coverage truth; when a runner interprets an unregistered
"},{"number":258,"text":"declaration; or when an invalid program can produce effects before its
"},{"number":259,"text":"diagnostic is emitted.
"}]},{"end_line":9,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE — Lawful Composition","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE%20%E2%80%94%20Lawful%20Composition","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md","sha256":"24a9a30185c1c974ef7fd420b639ba5541de9f918da4db938229756b40875203","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE — Lawful Composition

"}]},{"end_line":13,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE — Lawful Composition/Purpose","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE%20%E2%80%94%20Lawful%20Composition%2FPurpose","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md","sha256":"c521f396b12fdc82f082e2ea5e87a56b82415f3b4ea712af53349c40c3ab888c","start_line":10,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md","lines":[{"number":10,"text":"## Purpose
"},{"number":11,"text":"
"},{"number":12,"text":"Define lawful graph-function composition in GTL 3.
"},{"number":13,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":46,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE — Lawful Composition/Acceptance Criteria","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE%20%E2%80%94%20Lawful%20Composition%2FAcceptance%20Criteria","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md","sha256":"72560f090f73c2301ee975d735e76381e26628dd9f43ac9e131ce176ae9defb0","start_line":14,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE.md","lines":[{"number":14,"text":"## Acceptance Criteria
"},{"number":15,"text":"
"},{"number":16,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-001**: `compose(f, g)` shall compose two graph functions when `g.environment.requires` is satisfied by the cumulative environment carried by `f`. The result is a new graph function with `inputs = f.inputs` and `outputs = g.outputs`.
"},{"number":17,"text":"
"},{"number":18,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-002**: Composition shall be associative as a semantic law.
"},{"number":19,"text":"
"},{"number":20,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-003**: An identity graph function shall exist that preserves the interface under left and right composition.
"},{"number":21,"text":"
"},{"number":22,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-004**: Composed graph functions shall remain replayable. Composition structure and resulting truth shall be reconstructable from declarations plus runtime truth.
"},{"number":23,"text":"
"},{"number":24,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-005**: Composition shall propagate and deterministically merge composition-visible metadata such as `effects`, `tags`, and structured declarations.
"},{"number":25,"text":"
"},{"number":26,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-006**: Structured declaration merge shall fail closed on conflicting values rather than silently inventing composition semantics.
"},{"number":27,"text":"
"},{"number":28,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-007**: Composition shall preserve cumulative environment truth immutably. Upstream carried bindings remain available to downstream functions unless composition explicitly narrows the contract.
"},{"number":29,"text":"
"},{"number":30,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-008**: Composition shall fail closed when downstream required bindings are absent from the carried environment or structurally mismatch the available carried contracts.
"},{"number":31,"text":"
"},{"number":32,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-009**: Composition shall fail closed on conflicting carried output bindings rather than silently overwriting prior environment truth.
"},{"number":33,"text":"
"},{"number":34,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-010**: Composition shall distinguish endpoint port
"},{"number":35,"text":"identity from endpoint type contract. Exact name-and-contract composition
"},{"number":36,"text":"shall remain lawful, but it shall not be the only lawful form once explicit
"},{"number":37,"text":"type wiring is declared.
"},{"number":38,"text":"
"},{"number":39,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-011**: Type-sensitive composition shall permit
"},{"number":40,"text":"differently named endpoints to compose only when the provided endpoint type
"},{"number":41,"text":"satisfies the required endpoint type through declared GTL type law.
"},{"number":42,"text":"
"},{"number":43,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-COMPOSE-012**: Type-sensitive composition shall fail closed when
"},{"number":44,"text":"type refs are unknown, composed type obligations are weakened, or explicit
"},{"number":45,"text":"wiring is ambiguous. It shall not infer semantic equivalence from similar
"},{"number":46,"text":"names, tags, schema strings, or prompt prose.
"}]},{"end_line":9,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION - Epistemology Over Ratified Ontology","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION%20-%20Epistemology%20Over%20Ratified%20Ontology","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","sha256":"7ec9d1b4a2c2d39b9a98dcae927fb0c134def57261cde8a90cf2a6ddad8abac7","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION - Epistemology Over Ratified Ontology
"},{"number":2,"text":"
"},{"number":3,"text":"**Status**: Active

"},{"number":5,"text":"**Date**: 2026-07-11
"},{"number":6,"text":"**Derives from**: [SPEC_METHOD.md](stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md), [ODD_METHOD.md](stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/ODD_METHOD.md), [INTENT.md](../../INTENT.md) INT-001, [PRODUCT.md](../../PRODUCT.md), [REQ-L-GTL3-GRAPHFUNCTION.md](REQ-L-GTL3-GRAPHFUNCTION.md), [REQ-L-GTL3-GRAPHVECTOR.md](REQ-L-GTL3-GRAPHVECTOR.md), [REQ-L-GTL3-JOB.md](REQ-L-GTL3-JOB.md), [REQ-L-GTL3-EVALUATOR.md](REQ-L-GTL3-EVALUATOR.md), [REQ-L-GTL3-HOOKS.md](REQ-L-GTL3-HOOKS.md), [REQ-R-ABG3-FN-COMPOSITION.md](../abg/REQ-R-ABG3-FN-COMPOSITION.md), [REQ-R-ABG3-ASSURANCE.md](../abg/REQ-R-ABG3-ASSURANCE.md), [REQ-R-ABG3-PAYLOAD.md](../abg/REQ-R-ABG3-PAYLOAD.md), [T-143](../../../.ai-workspace/tickets/completed/T-143-define-gtl-compute-notation-types-over-ratified-carriers.md)
"},{"number":7,"text":"

"},{"number":9,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":21,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION - Epistemology Over Ratified Ontology/Purpose","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION%20-%20Epistemology%20Over%20Ratified%20Ontology%2FPurpose","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","sha256":"e56a71609fb3bf6567e059a7798b4f299ee3e8b862124042382b70908fcd11fb","start_line":10,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","lines":[{"number":10,"text":"## Purpose
"},{"number":11,"text":"
"},{"number":12,"text":"Define the GTL-facing epistemology over the ratified GTL ontology and ABG
"},{"number":13,"text":"runtime ontology without adding a new GTL topology object, ABG runtime carrier,
"},{"number":14,"text":"or execution target.
"},{"number":15,"text":"
"},{"number":16,"text":"The notation exists so authors and tools can distinguish what exists from how
"},{"number":17,"text":"it is known. Ontology names the lawful carriers. Epistemology names the
"},{"number":18,"text":"knowledge states over those carriers: candidate production, evaluation
"},{"number":19,"text":"findings, ABG admission, ABG ledger/projection truth, assurance fold,
"},{"number":20,"text":"traversal transition, and downstream consequence projection.
"},{"number":21,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":30,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION - Epistemology Over Ratified Ontology/Scope","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION%20-%20Epistemology%20Over%20Ratified%20Ontology%2FScope","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","sha256":"d43485643d3da93af8bdf192ab9a48ce80c9fc91de3a18e2f291cc579b01681d","start_line":22,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","lines":[{"number":22,"text":"## Scope
"},{"number":23,"text":"
"},{"number":24,"text":"This requirement governs notation such as `fn<A, B>.C`, `transform.C`,
"},{"number":25,"text":"`evaluate.C`, and `consequence.C`, and the ontology/epistemology boundary those
"},{"number":26,"text":"terms rely on.
"},{"number":27,"text":"
"},{"number":28,"text":"It is notation over existing GTL ontology and ABG runtime truth. It is not a
"},{"number":29,"text":"literal GTL language extension and not a second public carrier.
"},{"number":30,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":69,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION - Epistemology Over Ratified Ontology/Ontology Boundary","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION%20-%20Epistemology%20Over%20Ratified%20Ontology%2FOntology%20Boundary","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","sha256":"249082a7510236cf349856356a528cb391eaea7c88646478529e3dabd1da8917","start_line":31,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","lines":[{"number":31,"text":"## Ontology Boundary
"},{"number":32,"text":"
"},{"number":33,"text":"GTL ontology contains the authored language carriers:
"},{"number":34,"text":"
"},{"number":35,"text":"- `Graph`
"},{"number":36,"text":"- `Node`
"},{"number":37,"text":"- `GraphVector`
"},{"number":38,"text":"- `Context`
"},{"number":39,"text":"- `Operator`
"},{"number":40,"text":"- `Evaluator`
"},{"number":41,"text":"- `Rule`
"},{"number":42,"text":"- `GraphFunction`
"},{"number":43,"text":"- `RefinementBoundary`
"},{"number":44,"text":"- `CandidateFamily`
"},{"number":45,"text":"- `ContractRef`
"},{"number":46,"text":"- `Role`
"},{"number":47,"text":"- `Job`
"},{"number":48,"text":"- `Module`
"},{"number":49,"text":"
"},{"number":50,"text":"ABG runtime ontology contains ABG-admitted runtime truth, including:
"},{"number":51,"text":"
"},{"number":52,"text":"- selected `abg.fn_composition`
"},{"number":53,"text":"- runtime events
"},{"number":54,"text":"- `Run`
"},{"number":55,"text":"- `GraphCall`
"},{"number":56,"text":"- `Frame`
"},{"number":57,"text":"- `ExecutionBasis`
"},{"number":58,"text":"- `AdvancementTransition`
"},{"number":59,"text":"- `IterationAdvanceDecision`
"},{"number":60,"text":"- `Continuation`
"},{"number":61,"text":"- payload admission and payload ledgers
"},{"number":62,"text":"- assurance projection and closure fold
"},{"number":63,"text":"- traversal transition and replay projection
"},{"number":64,"text":"
"},{"number":65,"text":"Product ontology remains outside GTL and ABG. A downstream product may define
"},{"number":66,"text":"pressure maps, acceptance lenses, lifecycle registers, and domain read models,
"},{"number":67,"text":"but those meanings are product projections over ABG-admitted facts, not new GTL
"},{"number":68,"text":"or ABG ontology.
"},{"number":69,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":89,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION - Epistemology Over Ratified Ontology/Epistemic Boundary","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md#REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION%20-%20Epistemology%20Over%20Ratified%20Ontology%2FEpistemic%20Boundary","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","sha256":"c1c247bfbfe1659f12c3dffa592e8996b2924c0c93a206f255c12ad0b29f650f","start_line":70,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-COMPUTE-NOTATION.md","lines":[{"number":70,"text":"## Epistemic Boundary
"},{"number":71,"text":"
"},{"number":72,"text":"The stable epistemic flow is:
"},{"number":73,"text":"
"},{"number":74,"text":"```text
"},{"number":75,"text":"A
"},{"number":76,"text":"  -> transform.C
"},{"number":77,"text":"  -> candidate/evidence refs
"},{"number":78,"text":"  -> evaluate.C
"},{"number":79,"text":"  -> evaluation finding refs
"},{"number":80,"text":"  -> ABG admission
"},{"number":81,"text":"  -> ABG events, ledgers, assurance projection, traversal projection
"},{"number":82,"text":"  -> consequence.C
"},{"number":83,"text":"  -> product read-model interpretation
"},{"number":84,"text":"  -> B or lawful continuation
"},{"number":85,"text":"```
"},{"number":86,"text":"
"},{"number":87,"text":"`C` is selected composition notation: the selected `abg.fn_composition`
"},{"number":88,"text":"contract identity for the owning boundary.
"},{"number":89,"text":"
"}]}]
